purpose: Define invite-only group messaging governance with immutable owner identity, two delegated authority levels and explicit invite policy.

topics.name: Messaging Group Governance
topics.purpose: Define invite-only group messaging governance with immutable owner identity, two delegated authority levels and explicit invite policy.

semantics.join_rule: Group membership is invite-only unless a future explicit compatible policy says otherwise.
semantics.owner_rule: Group owner identity is immutable for the lifetime of that group identity.
semantics.delegation_rule: Two delegated authority levels are supported below owner.
semantics.invite_rule: Group may explicitly allow all members to invite, otherwise invitation follows delegated authority policy.
semantics.membership_rule: Member/delegation changes are explicit governed operations.
semantics.transport_rule: Group governance survives peer transport session changes.
semantics.authority_rule: Transport connectivity or message receipt does not grant group governance authority.

invariants.rule: Messaging is explicit peer/group communication over governed peer transport; rendezvous, transport, conversation policy and message payload remain separate semantic layers.

prose.summary: Define invite-only group messaging governance with immutable owner identity, two delegated authority levels and explicit invite policy.
